# GitShield CLI

## [3.1.0] - 2026-09-29

Automated Git pre-commit credential shield, zero-dependency secret auditor, and GitHub Actions CI runner.

### Added
- Automated Git pre-commit hook shield preventing committed OpenAI, AWS, and Stripe keys
- GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow template for automated pull request vulnerability scanning
- Added support for custom regular expression pattern files (.gitshieldignore)

### Changed
- 4x faster file hashing engine using multithreaded SHA-256 chunks
- Cleaned terminal ASCII summary reports with actionable remediation tips

### Fixed
- Fixed false positives on base64 encoded image assets in markdown docs
- Resolved path traversal warning on Windows NT file separators
